name: WHU Building Dataset (Aerial + Satellite)
source: Wuhan University — State Key Laboratory of Information Engineering in Surveying, Mapping and Remote Sensing
geography: New Zealand (aerial subset); Global satellite subset. NOT India-specific.
crs: EPSG:32760 (New Zealand aerial subset); WGS84 for satellite subset
labels: Binary building footprint masks (raster). Large-scale: 220k+ buildings annotated.
license: Free for research use with attribution. Commercial use requires permission from WHU.
provenance: Direct download from WHU GPCV Lab. Dataset paper: Ji et al., 2018.
limitations: HISTORICAL METADATA ONLY — NOT USED FOR TRAINING/VALIDATION/PRODUCTION INFERENCE. Foreign non-data.gov.in data. Prohibited from active training or inference under data.gov.in rule.
intended_use: HISTORICAL METADATA ONLY — NOT USED FOR TRAINING/VALIDATION/PRODUCTION INFERENCE. Authorized datasets must originate from data.gov.in or official state/UT portals.
